fields.title: Carrier and coating weights
fields.finding: ALD paper omits PET gauge; R10 ML3 zero-payload carrier limit is28.07um. SiOx/Verreal coat2g/m2 and foil adhesive3g/m2 are allowances.
fields.proposed_fix: Weigh the complete final laminate including all carrier, coatings, primer, adhesive and opacity layers. Do not use the12um recipe as a sourced product.

claim: ALD paper omits PET gauge; R10 ML3 zero-payload carrier limit is28.07um. SiOx/Verreal coat2g/m2 and foil adhesive3g/m2 are allowances. | Carrier and coating weights
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
